forms.title: Immigration forms
forms.intro: Browse common USCIS forms and what each one is for, in plain language. Free to look up. Always download and file forms on the official USCIS website, which never charges for its forms or online accounts.
forms.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, name, or purpose, e.g. I-130, work permit
forms.empty: No forms match your search. Try a different term or category.

resources.title: Find Free & Low-Cost Immigration Help
resources.intro: Nonprofits, pro-bono providers and DOJ-recognized organizations. Each one links back to the official government roster it came from.
resources.notarioTitle: Heads up: a notario is not a lawyer
resources.notarioBody: Only a licensed attorney or a DOJ-accredited representative at a recognized organization can give legal advice or represent you.
resources.emptyBody: Try clearing the state or cost filter. Search matches the organization's name only.
resources.ctaTitle: Describe your situation and Javi will point you to the right kind of help
resources.ctaBody: No account, nothing saved unless you ask.
resources.disclaimer: Listings are drawn from the DOJ EOIR pro-bono and Recognition & Accreditation rosters. Contact an organization directly to confirm current availability. A listing here isn't an endorsement.

reps.title: DOJ-Accredited Representatives
reps.intro: Not lawyers, but the Department of Justice authorizes them to represent you. Reach each one through their recognized organization.
reps.scopeHint: “Full accreditation” can represent you in immigration court (EOIR & the BIA) and before USCIS. “USCIS only” can file with USCIS (applications, petitions, renewals) but can't appear in court.
reps.scopeFullHint: Can appear for you before USCIS and in the immigration courts (EOIR) and the Board of Immigration Appeals.
reps.scopeDhsHint: Can file with USCIS (applications, petitions, renewals) but not appear in immigration court or before the BIA.
reps.expiresIn: Expires in {n} day | Expires in {n} days
reps.orgPhoneNote: The number is their organization's. The roster lists no direct line for the representative, so ask for them by name.
reps.noDirect: The roster lists no direct phone or email. Reach them through their organization.
reps.emptyBody: Try another state or clear the scope filter.
reps.expiredBody: A lapsed accreditation can't be used to represent you, so this directory hides expired entries and flags any that lapse within 90 days. Always confirm a representative's current standing on the official DOJ roster.
reps.rosterTitle: Check any representative against the official DOJ roster
reps.rosterBody: Every listing on this page was pulled from it. If a name isn't on the roster, walk away.
reps.disclaimer: Representatives come from the DOJ EOIR Recognition & Accreditation roster. A representative has no direct phone or email of their own. Reach them through their recognized organization.
